The same Ember Guardian Pip character: orange ember scales, cream featherlike neck/chest underside, amber eyes, rust red leaflike cheek and dorsal spines, cream swept horns, charcoal wing membranes carrying warm golden flame markings, orange leaf flame tail tip. Match the reference's detailed hand-painted storybook fantasy game illustration. Preserve identity, no redesign, no additional characters, no writing, no labels, no border. Background: perfectly plain deep near-black pine green (#071f1b), with very subtle warm ground contact shadow only; NO landscape, no glowing effects or particles (added by the app). Stage 0: The small youthful hatchling, matching the upper-left dragon of the reference sheet and portrait. Sitting on all four paws, little wings half open, short cream horns, big warm amber eyes, round short muzzle. Curious and approachable.
